Danil "'''donk'''" Kryshkovets {{born}} is a [[:Category:Russia|Russian]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player who plays for [[Team Spirit]] as an entry fragger. He is widely considered as one of the best riflers in the world ever since his breakthrough in late 2023, being named the best player of 2024 and the runner-up for the best player in 2025. <ref name="top24"/><ref name="top25"/> In addition, he has won 13 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] awards, including an MVP from a [[Majors|Major Championship]].

In 2024, his rookie year, donk would sweep the [[HLTV/Awards_Show|HLTV Awards]] winning Rookie, Opener, Highlight and Player of the year.

He is known for his long-standing performance and has gained a reputation as one of the greatest ''Counter-Strike'' players of all time. He is best known for his four years of tenure with [[Fnatic]], which he helped bring to prominence as the dominant team of 2009 and broke the record for the highest-earning team in a calendar year for ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' at the time, as well as his almost decade-long stint with [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]] that saw the team creating an invincible dynasty in the early days of ''[[Global Offensive]]'' with a record 87-map win streak. f0rest would announce his retirement in August 2024, ending a career spanning over 2 decades. '''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2026-06-05 — 2026-06-22|Fnatic|Inactive}} {{TH|2026-06-22 — '''Present'''|EYEBALLERS}} }} Freddy "'''KRIMZ'''" Johansson {{born}} is a [[:Category:Sweden|Swedish]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player. He is regarded as one of the most consistent players in the competitive scene and is known for his clutch ability. His partnership with [[olofmeister]] during [[Fnatic]]'s dominant period from late 2014 to early 2016 is regarded as one of the best duos in ''Counter-Strike'' history. KRIMZ joined Fnatic in 2014 and spent almost his entire career there, broken only by a three month stint with [[GODSENT]] in 2016. He is among the most decorated players in ''Global Offensive'' history, winning over 20 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments across his career. Among these accomplishments include two [[Majors]]. Isaković joined his first professional team, [[Renegades]], in April 2017 as the IGL, despite not having any experience in the role. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/20238|title=nexa joins Renegades|date=2017-04-13|author=[[Professeur]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}} Noah "[[Nifty]]" Francis would take over from the young rifler midway through [[IEM Sydney 2017]], prompting him to depart a few months later. '''nexa''' then formed the international [[MANS NOT HOT]]-[[The Imperial]] lineup, where he bounced around the role of an IGL multiple times after his captains departed. He was later acquired by [[G2 Esports]] as part of their transition to an international roster in late 2019, becoming their IGL. {{cite web|url=https://youtu.be/vxTLmpiB0J8|title=PRO je BRO #12 Nemanja "nexa" Isaković|language={{Flag|rs}} Serbian|date=2021-08-31|author=[[Đorđe Đurđev]]|publisher=[[TV ARENA ESPORT]]}} In January 2022, he was traded by [[G2]] to [[OG]] in exchange for Aleksi "[[Aleksib]]" Virolainen. {{cite web|url=https://ogs.gg/the-nexa-chapter/|title=The Nexa Chapter|date=2022-01-23|publisher=[[OG]]}} ==Gear and Settings== {{Mouse settings table |date=2021-07-24 |ref=[https://konect.gg/nexa nexa's Konect]{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/G2nexa/status/1418880150637273095|title=A little change in my setup|date=2021-07-24|author='''nexa'''}} |brand=Logitech|model=G PRO X SUPERLIGHT|desc=White |dpi=800 |polling=1000 |sensitivity=1.22 |zoom=1 |rawinput=On |windows=6 }} {{Hardware table |date=2021-07-24 |ref= |mouse-brand=Logitech|mouse-model=G PRO X SUPERLIGHT|mouse-desc=White |pad-brand=Logitech|pad-model=G640 |monitor-brand=AOC|monitor-model=AGON AG251FZ2E |refresh-rate=240 |w=1280|h=960|scaling=Stretched |keyboard-brand=Logitech|keyboard-model=G PRO X |headset-brand=Logitech|headset-model=G PRO X }} {{Crosshair table |date=2024-01-27 |ref={{cite_web|date=2024-01-27|url=https://www.hltv.org/matches/2368879/natus-vincere-vs-g2-blast-premier-spring-groups-2024|title=Natus Vincere vs. G2 at BLAST Premier Spring Groups 2024|publisher=[[HLTV]]}} |share_code=CSGO-TpLLK-EJ5vT-aYEpF-VphTW-k8aYO }} ==Achievements== {{Player achievements table|player=Nexa}} ==Highlights==

'''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2025-01-10 — '''Present'''|Team Vitality}} }} Robin "'''ropz'''" Kool {{born}} is an [[:Category:Estonia|Estonian]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player who currently plays for [[Team Vitality]]. ropz plays primarily as a rifler and [[:Category:Lurkers|lurker]], a role where he is considered to be one of the greatest of all time. ropz is among the most decorated ''CS:GO'' and ''CS2'' players, having won over 25 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments across his career, including three [[Majors|Major championships]] and a record three [[ESL/Grand Slam|ESL Grand Slams]]. He is also regarded as one of the greatest riflers of all time, having been ranked in every [[HLTV/Top_20_Players|HLTV Top 20 ranking]] since his debut, peaking at #3 in 2023 and 2025. ==Gear and '''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2023-10-26 — 2025-07-28|Natus Vincere|Inactive}} {{TH|2024-09-27 — 2024-11-21|Team Falcons|Loan}} {{TH|2025-05-05 — 2025-07-09|FaZe Clan|Loan}} {{TH|2025-07-28 — '''Present'''|BC.Game Esports}} }} Oleksandr "'''s1mple'''" Kostyliev {{born}} is a [[:Category:Ukraine|Ukrainian]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former professional ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player. Widely considered as the greatest and most accomplished ''[[CS:GO]]'' player of all time, he has won 21 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] medals, a [[PGL Major Stockholm 2021|Major]] and an [[Intel/Grand_Slam/3|Intel Grand Slam]] trophy, among other numerous [[:Category:S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier trophies]], and has been crowned as the best player of 2018, 2021, and 2022, and the runner-up for the best player of 2019 and 2020. In late 2023, s1mple announced he would be taking a break from competition, benching himself on [[Natus Vincere]], where he had played since 2017; citing personal reasons and a dislike towards the state of ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' at the time. Around one year later, s1mple would have a short loan stint with [[Team Falcons]] and later [[FaZe Clan]], before completing a shock transfer to [[BC.Game Esports|BC.Game]] in mid 2025. Mathieu "'''ZywOo'''" Herbaut {{born}} is a [[:Category:France|French]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former professional ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player who plays for [[Team Vitality]] as the [[:Category:AWPers|AWPer]]. He is widely considered as one of the greatest players of all time, being named the best player of 2019, 2020, 2023 and 2025, and a runner-up for the best player of 2021 and 2022. In addition, he has won a record 32 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] awards, three [[Majors|Major]] championships, including a record three Major MVP awards, and two [[ESL/Grand Slam|ESL Grand Slams]].

*Records tied to the [[HLTV/Top_20_Players|Top 20 Players of the Year]] ranking:
**Most appearances at No.1 (4), in the top 2 (6), in the top 3 and top 5 (7).
***Tied with [[NiKo]] for top 5.
**Most consecutive appearances at No.1 (2), in the top 2 (5), in the top 3 and top 5 (7).
***Tied with [[GeT_RiGhT]], [[coldzera]], and [[s1mple]] for No.1, and tied with [[s1mple]] for top 2.
*Only player to end a map between two "Top 30" teams on LAN without dying. <ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/HLTVorg/status/1523622303380406272|title=What does @zywoo say to the god of death? Not today|date=2022-05-09|author=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*Most kills in a single series (143), doing so at the [[ESL/Pro_League/Season_16|ESL Pro League Season 16]] grand final versus [[Team Liquid]]. <ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/34683|title=Vitality take down Liquid 3-2 in marathon series|date=2022-10-02|author=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
